samples.question: Read panels P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, and P6 from left to right. Each panel contains the same four labeled tokens A, B, C, and D, but their row positions may be shuffled. Each token shows one state from the ordered STATE KEY: LOW < MID < HIGH < PEAK. For each adjacent arrow, compare every pair of labels: a pair is a rank reversal if its state ordering changes from one panel to the next. Which arrow has the most pairwise state-rank reversals? Exactly one arrow wins. Answer P1->P2, P2->P3, P3->P4, P4->P5, or P5->P6.
